calendar_total_variance_mid.method: earlier mid total variance vs the later expiry's mid total variance interpolated linearly in k (diagnostic, not a certificate)

arbitrage.constraint_set: CRW 2020 Table 1: C1-C3 per expiry; C4, C5 and C6 (C6.1 a/b/c and the nearest-neighbour chord) between consecutive expiries only; see arbitrage.py

fit_set.rule: alternate strikes per expiry (even positions by strike), minus quotes the l1-BA repair moves outside their spread

inputs.r_ref_source: Treasury zero curve 2026-11-05 (bills + par curve, cc): r(91d) 4.0762%, r(1y) 4.2357%
inputs.source_reason: the newest stored Cboe book of the session; it passes the quote-state gates (quoted at or after the 16:00 ET close, 99.2% of near-ATM lines two-sided)

essvi.description: eSSVI global surface (theta, psi, rho per expiry); Gatheral-Jacquier butterfly conditions, monotone theta and wing slopes, and slice ordering certified on a 4,001-point k-grid; inverse half-spread weights

butterfly_certificate.certificate: svi.butterfly_certificate: Durrleman g on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000), every local minimum refined by golden-section search, and the |k| -> inf limit 1/4 - (b(1 +- rho))^2/16

calendar_ordering.certificate: svi.ordering_certificate: w_{i+1} - w_i >= -1e-10 on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000) with every local minimum refined; wing slopes b(1 +- rho) non-decreasing to 1e-10; on a wing whose slopes tie, the asymptotic intercept ordered to 1e-10
calendar_ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

svi.description: raw SVI per expiry; Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] plus cutting planes until svi.butterfly_certificate passes, and Lee wing bounds; no calendar constraint between slices; inverse half-spread weights

butterfly_certificate.certificate: svi.butterfly_certificate: Durrleman g on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000), every local minimum refined by golden-section search, and the |k| -> inf limit 1/4 - (b(1 +- rho))^2/16

calendar_ordering.certificate: svi.ordering_certificate: w_{i+1} - w_i >= -1e-10 on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000) with every local minimum refined; wing slopes b(1 +- rho) non-decreasing to 1e-10; on a wing whose slopes tie, the asymptotic intercept ordered to 1e-10
calendar_ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

svi_cal.description: raw SVI per expiry with Durrleman g(k) >= 0 rows on 481 points of k in [-3, 2] and Lee wing bounds, and calendar ordering w_(i-1) <= w_i <= w_(i+1); a slice is accepted only when svi.butterfly_certificate and svi.ordering_certificate pass (cutting planes until they do); block coordinate descent from the eSSVI fit; inverse half-spread weights

butterfly.certificate: svi.butterfly_certificate: Durrleman g on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000), every local minimum refined by golden-section search, and the |k| -> inf limit 1/4 - (b(1 +- rho))^2/16

ordering.certificate: svi.ordering_certificate: w_{i+1} - w_i >= -1e-10 on CERT_GRID (k in [-3, 2] at 1e-4 spacing; tails uniform in 1/k out to k = 2,000 and -3,000) with every local minimum refined; wing slopes b(1 +- rho) non-decreasing to 1e-10; on a wing whose slopes tie, the asymptotic intercept ordered to 1e-10
ordering.check_grid: essvi.CHECK_GRID (4,001 points on k in [-3, 2] plus |k| = 10, 30)

universe_filters.note: identical to JointCalibrator.spx_surface_full; 0-6 DTE expiries are excluded, as in the calibrator
